newsitem.title: USA: Allied Capital Commercial sets extra div.
newsitem.headline: Allied Capital Commercial sets extra div.

text.p: Allied Capital Commercial Corp said on Tuesday it declared an extra $0.10 per share dividend, payable on January 31 to shareholders of record on December 27.
The company said this was the fourth consecutive year it had declared an annual extra dividend. Last year's payment was $0.17.
When the REIT increased its a quarterly dividend to $0.50 from $0.48 in November, it said it expected a year-end extra payment of between $0.08 and $0.11 per share.
